tool_args.rationale: The previous smooth attenuation fit was refuted, and an additional open-branch measurement is unavailable because that probe was already purchased. The nine observations still support a stationary input-and-gradient siphon mechanism; fit both signed square-root branch variants numerically and let least squares select the better one for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: That probe was already purchased; the server reports no additional training row.
All observed gradients are at or below 2.2, so the supercritical threshold regime has not been entered and this probe is not the most relevant discriminator.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a coupled memory ODE or slow-horizon adaptation law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations use the same long H=0.6; the refutation is better addressed by the identified branch ambiguity, not by adding horizon dynamics without a varying-H observation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a two-layer siphon with an open signed branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Selected: the observations vary current input and sink gradient, and the source notes describe this structure with a branch term; numerically choose its sign by least squares.
